Boqian New Materials.why: Supplies nickel powder for MLCC electrodes; the company calls itself an important supplier of nickel powder for MLCC and expects to benefit from high-end (AI server) MLCC demand
Boqian New Materials.evidence: Boqian New Materials investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-17-2026): the company has long-term stable cooperation with the world's leading MLCC manufacturers and multiple nickel-based product specifications are in volume supply

players.product: Ultra-fine, high-purity nickel-based powders for MLCC electrodes (volume supply to global MLCC makers); also copper and silver-coated copper powders

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: H1 2026 sales volume of its nickel-based products grew year on year; product pricing is the average nickel raw-material price over the 1 or 3 months before the customer's order plus a processing fee. Its new nickel powder lines can produce multiple specifications and will be scheduled flexibly to downstream customers' actual orders; it does not separately disclose the gross margin of small-particle nickel powder.
